result.brief: 提出 SuperJEPA，将监督目标融入联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），在高能物理喷注数据上验证自监督预测表征预训练优于纯监督预训练。
result.reason: Introduces SuperJEPA, a JEPA-style joint-embedding predictive architecture with supervised objective; JEPA self-supervised representation learning is directly in scope, though applied to HEP jets not vision.
